# do_ActivityHeatmap() | Activity scores heatmap

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

Activity heatmaps display activity scores (from tools like decoupleR) across cells or groups.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_ActivityHeatmap(sample = sample,
                                activities = activity_scores)
p
```
